4 ring writes per boot (720-B blob, ~25 entries each).

The result screen line and the NOT SAVED notice tell the rider to 'Open Cyclift to copy it' even when Bluetooth is unavailable this start (the likely case on the owner's board) - the RAM ride then cannot reach the phone and is lost at power-off.

RAM-only rides are never released after the phone has received them (SYNC_RIDE), so after 4 rides per power cycle every further ride is LOST ('RIDE NOT SAVED ... 4 unsynced rides already wait') even if all 4 are already on the phone.
Quick-settings SLEEP (deep sleep) and RESTART drop RAM-only rides without a warning (only 'ride active' blocks sleep).
